Improve your cognitive skills to learn and cast faster, become able to appraise targets and use analysis to copy skills and process materials to craft or replicate items or equipment.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Parallel Processing: Increases the amount of Learned Points and Mastery Points gained when learning/using Skills, Magic, Battlewill, and Arts by 9 (10 Total).
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Chant Annulment: For Mastered Magic, completely fills up the Magic Circle's MP meter instantly.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Thought Acceleration
Active
[Active - Press] - Analytical Appraisal: Analysis Level 2, distance 20 blocks (30 with Mastery), If a target has greater than 5x (10x with Mastery) the player's EP, then only its base stats are shown (Name, HP, SHP, Armor).
Active: [Active] - Analysis: When used while looking at a mob, copies 1 of the Magic, and Skills (Except Unique Skills & Resistances) of a target. Can copy from up to 20 blocks away while in line of sight of entity or magic circle and won't work on any spirit related magic. Ineffective against Ultimate Skill Users. 25% Chance at Success, which raises to 50% with Mastery - 10s cooldown (5s if failed).
Active: [Active] - Refining: Opens a GUI that can be used to craft things, brew potions and process magic ore
Crafting tab: Works like a normal crafting table. Put an item in the replication slot on the left, to craft that item like a smithing bench without the need of Schematics, the user can replicate that item just by having the materials in the crafting grid. Has a button on the right to auto craft desired items in each 5 seconds.
Refining tab: Brewing any potions like brewing stand but all at once in 5 seconds. If a Hipokute Grass is placed into a slot with any bottle, it "brews" into a High Potion. If a Hipokute Flower is placed into a slot with any bottle,, it brews into a Full Potion. If a Magic Ore|link=Magic Ore Shard|image=Magic Ore Shard.gif is placed into a slot, "brews" into 2 Pure Magisteel Nuggets|link=Pure Magisteel Nugget|image=Pure Magisteel Nugget.gif.

GreatSage compatibility: Tap the Analytical Appraisal key (V by default) to toggle the interface, or hold it to appraise. Tensura manual dodging is paused while the appraisal interface is open. After closing it and releasing the key, press the dodge key again to dodge normally.

GreatSage cycle-analysis feedback: If analysis cannot start, the analysis interface displays the specific reason as silent subtitles, such as an unlearned or already mastered skill, all analysis threads being occupied, or an insufficient GreatSage level. Skills with a zero analysis cost do not require magicule storage; positive-cost analysis still checks magicules and deducts the cost under the existing rules.

Lead the charge with your allies. Empower yourself and your allies to give yourself an overwhelming advantage.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Thought Acceleration
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Inspire Forces Boosts the stats of all allies in 30 block radius by 30% (60% with Mastery) and gives them 30% Crit chance (60% with Mastery).
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Predictive Calculation: 10% Chance to auto-dodge an attack. 50% Chance to ignore dodge on enemies. Nullification is treated as resistance and resistance is bypassed. Magic Jamming's damage mitigation is ignored.
Active
[Active - Press] Thought Communication: Able to give commands to allies similar to Thought Communication.
Active: [Active - Press] Thought Domination: Works like Vampire’s Charm.

Grind the world to a halt. Put your enemies into a deadly sleep, drain their power and rest to regain any lost vitality. May lethargy take over.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Phantasmal Strike (Requires Learning): When activated, applies an effect to the player's attacks that deals 10 (+1% of target’s max SHP with Mastery) Spiritual damage.
Active
[Active - Hold] - Deep Hypno: While looking at a mob, adds one level of Drowsiness every 10 seconds (15 with spiritual resistance, 20 with nullification) and 5 (10 with Mastered) seconds of duration. Each level of sleep reduces movement speed by 25% and has an additional effect identical to weakness and fragility. On lvl 5, it kills the target instantly. When used on a magic circle, will destroy the magic circle and place it on a 3 second cooldown (5 seconds with mastery).
Active: [Active - Hold] - Fallen Hypno: Deep Hypno but within an Aoe radius of 10x10 (20x20 if mastered) and has double the casting time - 20 seconds (25 with spiritual resistance, 30 with nullification).
Active: [Active - Hold] - Deprive: Drains 1000 MP (+0.3% target’s max MP with Mastery) and deals 10 (+1% of target’s max SHP with Mastery) Spiritual Damage every second while looking at a mob within 5 (15 with Mastery) blocks. If used on a mob with spiritual HP below 50%, they become tamed/subordinate to the player.
Active: [Active - Hold] - Rest: While held down, makes the player unable to move, attack, or activate other abilities. Regen 10 (+1% of target’s max with Mastery) HP and Spiritual HP per sec and increases the players MP, and AP Regen by 10X. If MP is at max, it fills up a temporary MP storage at the same rate. If there is enough MP in the temporary storage (1000 x Y = X [Y = Number of Allies. X = Cost]), right clicking will restore 1000 MP, 1000 AP, 50 HP and 10 Spiritual HP to all allies within a 30x30 radius.
Active: [Active - Press] - Fallen Strike (Requires Phantasmal Style. Requires Mastery.): At the cost of 5,000MP, deals 500 Spiritual Damage to the looked at target. Ignores Spiritual Attack Resistance and Nullification. [Cooldown 10s]

Rupture the floor, raising your natural body temperature to liquefy all surfaces around you to molten levels.

Active
[Active] Hell Hall - Turn all blocks in a 8x8 (16x16 with mastery) radius around the player into lava. Does not work if water is nearby.

Command your absolute authority over Deceleration, allowing you to freeze all enemies with ice and spew superchilled ice. Additionally, freeze the surroundings into ice.

Passive
[Passive] Thermal Drop - Lower your body temperature to inflict Freezing and Spike all enemies you touch. Additionally, while in slot, all Cold attacks deal 2x more damage.
Active
[Active] Ice Breath - Spew superchilled shards of frost at your enemy which are 2x stronger than that of the intrinsic Ice Breath. Stacks with the passive.
Active: [Active] Freezing Point - Instantly chill and freeze all nearby blocks (16x16) blocks into Ice. Works anywhere so long as the skillgrief gamerule is not on.

Can only be used during a thunderstorm
Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Increases damage dealt by Lightning related attacks by 1.5x. Doesn't stack with Lightning Domination.
Active
[Active - Press] When activated, spawns lightning where you're looking, costing 20 MP.

Doesn't stack with Lightning Manipulation
Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Increases damage dealt by Lightning related attacks by 3x. Mastery grants Electricity attack resistance/nullification degradation if the user has 800k ep.
Active
[Active - Press] When activated, if thundering, spawn lightning where player looks, 20 MP.

Purify and renew. Remove all negative effects and restore vitality to those under your care.

Active
[Active - Press] When used while not looking at a target, remove all negative status effects from the user and restore their hp to full including Severance damage. When looking at a mob, remove all their negative status effects and restores their hp to full. Costs 60 MP (40 with Mastery) each healed HP and 100 MP each effect level removed.

Change your fate to survive fatal blows, regenerate instantly and manipulate probability.

Passive
[Passive - True] - Destiny Change: If the player would die, instead restore them to full HP, remove negative status effects, and restore their MP and AP up to 50% (75% with Mastery) of their maximum total. This applies for EACH type of damage once a Minecraft day (20 minutes). Once this ability is triggered, the skill will start its 20 mins cooldown, the skill can still be used during the cooldown, when the 20 mins cooldown runs out, the user can again revive from the death type that they already endured during the last 20 mins.
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] - Unexpected Result: (Becomes Toggleable with Mastery) If the player's HP is below 25%, grants a Strength 10 Buff, + 0.2 Attack Speed, + 0.04 Movement Speed, + 1 Swim Speed, and 15% physical attack auto-dodge chance. (double all buffs with Mastery)

Allow rage to consume you to massively improve your physical powers for a time before the aftereffects set in.

Active
[Active - Press] - Grants an effect equivalent to Strength 10 and gives the user an additional 10 Armour Points and +0.03 Speed. It lasts for 3 Minutes and upon ending inflicts the player with Paralysis 2, Fragility 2, and Weakness 2 for 10 Minutes. Mastery increases the duration to 6 Minutes. Costs 5,000 MP
Can't be activated along with the following skills
Dragon Mode
Beast Transformation
Magic Flame Transform
Magic Water Transform
Magic Wind Transform
Magic Earth Transform
Magic Space Transform
Magic Light Transform
Magic Darkness Transform

Empower your body by a massive amount but beware the aftereffects.

[Active - Press] Divine Release: Grants an effect equivalent to Strength 20, gives the user an additional 20 Armour Points, and +0.06 Speed. It lasts for 3 Minutes and upon ending inflicts the player with Paralysis 2, Fragility 2, and Weakness 2 for 10 Minutes. Mastery increases the duration to 6 Minutes and double the stat boost. During the duration, all damage taken is treated as physical damage. Every battlewill attack the user does in this mode will deal x6 damage (x8 with Mastery). Costs 10,000 MP and deals 10HP in damage every second while active. [Activate again to turn off the effect but still gets the debuff and cooldown]

Use your Divine Ki to amplify your battlewill to deal more damage and destroy weaker equipment.

[Passive - Toggle] - Increases the user’s battlewill damage by 100 damage (200 with Mastery) and deals x3 durability damage (x5 with Mastery) on targets’ armor at legend grade or below when dealing Physical or Battlewill. If copied, cannot be used without Divinity. Grants Physical Resistance/Nullification degradation.
Can attack Spiritual Entities

Achieve mastery through discipline. Learn combat and magic abilities instantly, gain more mastery points, and hit much harder.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Makes learning Battlewills and Magic happen instantly
Passive: [Passive - True] - The player earns 2 more mastery points with each usage.
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] - The player gets +75 base damage (+150 With Mastery) Can select damage output by holding skill activation and scrolling mouse wheel.

Empower your attacks with the effect of Poison, with mastery you can do this automatically.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] - Inflicts Poison onto target - Fatal Poison when Mastered [Toggleable if mastered]. 0 MP

Channel your inner poison to inject deadly venom into your target trough every pore.

Active
[Active, Hold] Poison Transform: At the cost of 50% speed, deal 2 poison damage and apply "Deadly Poison" for all mobs within a 10x10 radius

Use your disgusting breath to corrode and nauseate your targets.

Active
[Active - Hold] - Breath attack that applies the Noxious and Corrosion effects to all targets touched, with 15 damage each sec (39 with mastery). 100MP per 20 Ticks
